candidates.label: Period independent of launch angle at every amplitude
candidates.hypothesis: Pendulum period is independent of initial angle for all amplitudes.
assumptions: The small-angle approximation remains valid at arbitrarily large angles.
Length, local gravity, air drag and launch procedure are controlled.
alternatives: Angle-dependent nonlinear dynamics predict a longer period at larger amplitudes.

discriminating_tests.measurement: Measure period for several preregistered initial angles at fixed length and location, with error bars.
discriminating_tests.prediction_if_claim: Periods agree across angles within preregistered uncertainty.
discriminating_tests.prediction_if_alternative: Period changes with angle beyond preregistered uncertainty.
discriminating_tests.decision_rule: Compare a constant-period model against an amplitude-dependent model on withheld trials; publish errors and controls.
